info.name: SupportFlow API — Production
info.description:
## SupportFlow REST API Collection

Complete API reference for all SupportFlow backend endpoints.

### Base URL
- **Development:** `http://localhost:5000/api/v1`
- **Production:** `https://api.yourdomain.com/api/v1`

### Authentication
All protected endpoints require a **Firebase ID Token** in the `Authorization` header:
```
Authorization: Bearer {{firebase_id_token}}
```

### How to Use
1. Set the `base_url` variable to your server.
2. Set `firebase_id_token` after calling `/auth/sync`.
3. Run the **Auth** folder first to populate variables.

### Role Abbreviations
- **PA** = PLATFORM_ADMIN
- **BA** = BUSINESS_ADMIN
- **SA** = SUPPORT_AGENT
- **CU** = CUSTOMER

item.name: 🔐 Auth
item.description:
Authentication endpoints — user registration, login, profile, and provider management.

**Rate Limited:** 100 requests / 15 minutes per IP.

request.description:
**Public endpoint.** Check if an email is registered and which auth providers are linked.

Use this on the login/register page to determine whether to show login or register UI.

**Requires:** `Authorization: Bearer <Firebase_ID_Token>`

Register a new Business Admin. The Firebase ID Token is obtained from the Firebase SDK after the user creates their account.

**Roles:** All

⚠️ Set `firebase_id_token` in collection variables before running.

item.name: 🎫 Tickets
item.description:
Support ticket management — create, list, view, update status, assign agents, internal notes, and CSAT ratings.

All endpoints require authentication. Access is scoped by role:
- **Customers** see only their own tickets
- **Agents** see assigned tickets
- **Business Admins** see all tickets in their business
- **Platform Admins** see all tickets

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Cannot login to my account",
  "description": "I have been trying to reset my password for the past 2 days but the reset email never arrives in my inbox. I have checked spam as well.",
  "category": "TECHNICAL_ISSUE",
  "priority": "HIGH",
  "businessId": "{{business_id}}"
}

item.name: 📬 Invitations
item.description:
Agent invitation management — invite, verify, accept invitations, and manage team members.

Most endpoints require `BUSINESS_ADMIN` role. Verify and Accept are public.

request.description:
Invite a support agent to join the business. Sends an email with a unique invitation link.

**Roles:** `BUSINESS_ADMIN` only

`role`: `SUPPORT_AGENT` | `BUSINESS_ADMIN` (default: `SUPPORT_AGENT`)

Get all active team members and pending invitations for the business.

**Roles:** `BUSINESS_ADMIN` only

Activate or deactivate a support agent's account. Deactivated agents cannot log in or access tickets.

**Roles:** `BUSINESS_ADMIN` only

Cancel and permanently delete a pending invitation.

**Roles:** `BUSINESS_ADMIN` only

**Public endpoint.** Verify an invitation token before showing the acceptance form. Called when the invited agent opens the link from their email.

**Auth:** Not required

response.name: 400 — Token expired or invalid

request.description:
**Public endpoint.** Accept an invitation and create the agent's account in the system.

The agent must first register via Firebase (Email/Password or Google), then call this endpoint with the Firebase UID.

**Auth:** Not required

`authProvider`: `EMAIL_PASSWORD` | `GOOGLE`

response.name: 201 — Account created

item.name: 💳 Subscriptions
item.description:
Razorpay subscription billing — create payment orders, verify payments, cancel/downgrade plans, and handle webhooks.

Upgrade/cancel/downgrade require `BUSINESS_ADMIN` role. The webhook endpoint is public (HMAC-verified).

request.description:
Get the current subscription details and usage stats for the authenticated user's business.

**Roles:** All authenticated users

Create a Razorpay payment order to initiate the checkout modal on the frontend.

**Roles:** `BUSINESS_ADMIN` only

`plan`: `STANDARD` | `BUSINESS`
`billingCycle`: `monthly` | `yearly`

Prices:
- STANDARD Monthly: ₹2,499
- STANDARD Yearly: ₹24,990
- BUSINESS Monthly: ₹6,499
- BUSINESS Yearly: ₹64,990

Verify Razorpay payment signature after the user completes checkout. On success, activates the subscription.

**Roles:** `BUSINESS_ADMIN` only

The `razorpay_signature` is provided by the Razorpay SDK after payment completion.

Cancel the active subscription. The business retains its current plan features until `currentPeriodEnd`, then downgrades to FREE.

**Roles:** `BUSINESS_ADMIN` only

response.name: 200 — Cancellation scheduled

request.description:
Schedule a downgrade to a lower plan at the end of the current billing period.

**Roles:** `BUSINESS_ADMIN` only

`targetPlan`: `STANDARD` | `FREE`

response.name: 200 — Downgrade scheduled

request.description:
**Called by Razorpay servers only. Not called from client code.**

HMAC-SHA256 signature verified using `RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET`.

**Supported events:**
- `payment.captured`
- `payment.failed`
- `subscription.charged`
- `subscription.cancelled`

⚠️ Configure this URL in the Razorpay Dashboard → Settings → Webhooks.

item.name: 📊 Dashboard
item.description:
Role-specific dashboard metrics and analytics. All endpoints require authentication.

- `/business` → Business Admin metrics
- `/agent` → Agent performance
- `/platform` → Platform Admin super-stats
- `/ratings` → CSAT ratings breakdown

request.description:
Get business-level metrics: total tickets, open/resolved counts, average resolution time, CSAT score, agent count, and trend charts.

**Roles:** `BUSINESS_ADMIN` only

Get personal agent performance metrics: assigned tickets, resolved count, avg resolution time, CSAT score.

**Roles:** `SUPPORT_AGENT`, `BUSINESS_ADMIN`

Get platform-wide super admin metrics: total businesses, users, tickets, subscription breakdown.

**Roles:** `PLATFORM_ADMIN` only

Suspend or reactivate a business account. Suspended businesses cannot log in or use the platform.

**Roles:** `PLATFORM_ADMIN` only

Get CSAT (Customer Satisfaction) rating breakdown and recent feedback.

**Roles:** `SUPPORT_AGENT`, `BUSINESS_ADMIN`
